description: Perfect tea every time — pick your tea type for the right steep time, water temperature and brewing notes.

faqs.a: Green 2 min at 80°C, white 4 min at 75°C, oolong 3 min at 90°C, black 4 min at 100°C, herbal 6 min at 100°C.
faqs.q: What steep times does it use?

faqs.a: Boiling water scorches delicate green and white teas, making them bitter. Let boiled water sit a minute or two to cool to the right temperature.
faqs.q: Why not use boiling water for all teas?

faqs.a: Yes — restart the timer for each infusion and add ~30 seconds for every additional steep.
faqs.q: Can I use it for multiple infusions?

howto: Choose your tea type from the dropdown.
Check the recommended water temperature and notes.
Press Start steeping and wait for the beep.
Remove the leaves or bag and enjoy.
title: Tea Steep Timer
